title: Chehlum tera karne ko bahen aayi hai bhai
body:
DUKH PAYI HAI BHAI MAJAYI HAI BHAI..
Dukh payi hai bhai majayi hai bhai, Chehlum tera karne ko behen ayi hai bhai.
Aye bhai banane ko lahad aj tumhari, Taqdeer mujhe shaam se yaa'n layi hai bhai.
Mai sadqe mere bekaso mazloom beradar, Kya bekasi lashe pe tere chayi hai bhai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh jungle sunsan hai aur tum ho main qurbaan, Ab ap hai aur qabr ki tanhayi hai bhai.
Rona na mila apke lashe pe behen ko, Matam tera karne ke liye aayi hai bhai.
Kode the ilaaj e tape Sajjad safar me, Bimaar ne kya qoob dawa payi hai bhai.
Darbaar me maiqaar ne jis waqt bulaya, Muh balon se dhape yeh behen aayi hai bhai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mar margayi zindaa'n me bahen sharm ke maare, Jab Hind ke aane ki khabar payi hai bhai.
Zinda me Sakina bhi huwi mout ke paale, Dafna ke bhatiji ki khabar layi hai bhai.
'Baqar' pe tar ham ki nazar chahiye har dam, Zakir bhi hai aur apka shaidayi hai bhai..
